kick.name: Kick
kick.desc: A quick kick for a little extra damage.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Draws your target's attention to you.

gate.name: Gate
gate.desc: Returns you to your bind point.

bind_wound.name: Bind Wound
bind_wound.desc: Bandage yourself between fights. Standing still, four seconds.

bash.name: Bash
bash.desc: Slam your target with your shield, with a chance to stun it for 2 seconds (not foes more than 3 levels above you). Requires a shield.

courage.name: Courage
courage.desc: For fifteen minutes: +4 AC, +10 HP. Cast it on friends.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: The hearth's wrath, called down on your foe.

hearthward.name: Hearthward
hearthward.land_text: Warmth settles over you like a cloak.
hearthward.desc: For twenty minutes: +8 AC, +25 HP. Replaces Courage's role later on.

burning_embers.name: Burning Embers
burning_embers.desc: Sets your target smoldering: damage every 3 seconds for 18 seconds.

root.name: Root
root.desc: Roots your target in place for up to 18 seconds. It still fights anything in reach.

circle_of_mending.name: Circle of Mending
circle_of_mending.desc: Mends everyone in your group within 30 m, you included.

hearthbond.name: Hearthbond
hearthbond.land_text: The hearth's warmth binds you to your companions.
hearthbond.desc: For twenty minutes, everyone in your group within 30 m: +3 AC, +8 HP.

spirit_bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
spirit_bolt.desc: A shaman's bolt of angry spirits.

grave_chill.name: Grave Chill
grave_chill.land_text: A deathly cold seeps into your bones.

blessing_of_the_elders.name: Blessing of the Elders
blessing_of_the_elders.desc: The elephant gods watch over those new to the world.

heroic_strike.name: Heroic Strike
heroic_strike.desc: Put your whole weight behind one blow. Grows with your Offense.

rally.name: Rally
rally.land_text: A rallying roar lifts your spirits!
rally.desc: Your group, for a minute: +2 damage, +5 AC.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.land_text: You set your shield and brace yourself.
shield_wall.desc: Brace behind your shield: +20 AC for 20 seconds. Requires a shield.

blessed_armor.name: Blessed Armor
blessed_armor.land_text: Holy light hardens around you like armor.

circle_of_renewal.name: Circle of Renewal
circle_of_renewal.desc: Heals everyone in your group nearby.

hallowed_strike.name: Hallowed Strike
hallowed_strike.desc: Holy fire called down on your foe.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.desc: A lance of ice driven through your foe.

emberstorm.name: Emberstorm
emberstorm.desc: Burns your target every 3 seconds for 18 seconds.

ice_comet.name: Ice Comet
ice_comet.desc: Calls a comet of ice down on your foe.

leech_bite.name: Leech Bite
leech_bite.land_text: The leech's teeth sink in, and you begin to bleed.
leech_bite.desc: A bog leech drinking your blood.

marsh_bolt.name: Marsh Bolt
marsh_bolt.desc: A Mirescale shaman's bolt of stinking marsh water.

drowning_cold.name: Drowning Cold
drowning_cold.desc: The cold of the drowned, who never left the mere.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Drive a piercing weapon into your target's back: you must be behind it. Double damage as an opener from hiding.

hide.name: Hide
hide.desc: Melt into the shadows: monsters not already after you won't notice you. Moving (unless you sneak), attacking or using another ability ends it. Use again to step out.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.desc: Move quietly at half speed; while sneaking, walking doesn't end Hide. Use again to stop.

evade.name: Evade
evade.desc: Slip out of sight for a heartbeat: everything fighting you loses much of its anger at you. Better with your Hide skill.

envenom_blade.name: Envenom Blade
envenom_blade.land_text: You coat your blade in poison.
envenom_blade.fade_text: The poison on your blade has dried.
envenom_blade.desc: For a minute, your weapon hits may poison: a venom that burns for 15 seconds.

rake.name: Rake
rake.dot_text: %s is bleeding from a deep gash.
rake.land_text: A blade rakes you open; you're bleeding.
rake.desc: A vicious slash that leaves your target bleeding for 12 seconds.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.desc: A challenge roared at everything within 10 m: they all turn on you.

defensive_stance.name: Defensive Stance
defensive_stance.land_text: You settle into a defensive stance.
defensive_stance.desc: For 45 seconds: +30 AC, but -3 damage. For holding a crowd off a friend.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: A great sweeping blow: your target and, for less, every foe within 4 m of it.

divine_aura.name: Divine Aura
divine_aura.land_text: A golden light surrounds you; nothing can touch you.
divine_aura.desc: For 8 seconds, no harm can reach you. Once every five minutes.

sunfire.name: Sunfire
sunfire.desc: The light of the Dawn-Tusk's first sunrise, burning your foe.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.desc: A crack of lightning at your foe.

frost_snare.name: Frost Snare
frost_snare.desc: Frost binds your target's legs: it moves at half speed for 24 seconds.
frost_snare.snare_you: Frost binds your legs; you slow to a crawl.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A ball of fire that bursts over your target, burning every foe within 8 m. Careful where you aim it.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.desc: From hiding and from behind only: a killing blow with a piercing weapon.

blind.name: Blind
blind.desc: Dust in the eyes: your target can't fight or move for 5 seconds.
blind.stun_text: You throw dust in %s's eyes; it staggers, blinded.
blind.stun_you: You are blinded and can't act!

deadly_poison.name: Deadly Poison
deadly_poison.land_text: You coat your blades in a deadly poison.
deadly_poison.fade_text: The deadly poison on your blades has dried.
deadly_poison.desc: For 90 seconds, your hits may carry a deadly venom (stronger than Envenom Blade).

deadly_venom.name: Deadly Venom
deadly_venom.land_text: A deadly poison burns in the wound.

dawn_tusk_blessing.name: Dawn-Tusk's Blessing
dawn_tusk_blessing.land_text: Warm light settles on your shoulders: the Dawn-Tusk sees you.
dawn_tusk_blessing.desc: For half an hour: +12 AC and +40 hit points. Prabhagaj's gift to his followers, once an hour at his shrine in Lanternhold.

scorpion_venom.name: Scorpion Venom
scorpion_venom.land_text: The sting burns like fire through your blood.

salt_gaze.name: Salt Gaze
salt_gaze.desc: A salt basilisk's stare: your limbs stiffen with salt and you slow to half speed.
salt_gaze.snare_you: The basilisk's gaze crusts your limbs with salt; you slow to a crawl.

shield_slam.name: Shield Slam
shield_slam.desc: Drive your shield into your target: heavy damage and a good chance to stun it for 3 seconds (not foes more than 5 levels above you). Requires a shield.

battle_fury.name: Battle Fury
battle_fury.land_text: A battle fury takes you; your arms move faster than thought.
battle_fury.desc: For 30 seconds: 30% faster swings and +4 damage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Spin through everything around you: your target and every foe within 5 m of it, almost as hard.

healing_tide.name: Healing Tide
healing_tide.desc: A wave of healing washes over everyone in your group nearby.

word_of_awe.name: Word of Awe
word_of_awe.stun_text: %s staggers, stunned by the word of your god.
word_of_awe.stun_you: A holy word strikes you still!
word_of_awe.desc: A holy word that stuns your target for 3 seconds.

armor_of_faith.name: Armor of Faith
armor_of_faith.land_text: Faith settles on you like armor.
armor_of_faith.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +15 AC, +60 HP, +2 HP regeneration.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that strikes your target and leaps to every foe within 6 m of it.

arcane_harvest.name: Arcane Harvest
arcane_harvest.land_text: You draw power from the air around you.
arcane_harvest.desc: For 12 seconds you draw mana from the air: +15 mana a tick. Once every ten minutes.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: Call a burning stone down on your target; everything within 6 m takes half.

crippling_poison.name: Crippling Poison
crippling_poison.land_text: You coat your blades in a crippling poison.
crippling_poison.fade_text: The crippling poison on your blades has dried.
crippling_poison.desc: For 90 seconds, your hits may cripple: the target slows to half speed for 10 seconds.

crippling_venom.name: Crippling Venom
crippling_venom.snare_text: %s staggers as the poison cripples its legs.
crippling_venom.snare_you: Poison numbs your legs; you slow to a crawl.

eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
eviscerate.desc: A vicious strike with whatever you hold.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.desc: Disappear mid-fight: everything hunting you forgets you, and you are hidden. Once every five minutes.

fish.name: Fishing
fish.desc: Cast your line into the water in front of you. Uses a can of worms; what bites depends on the water.

frog_poison.name: Frog Poison
frog_poison.land_text: The frog's poison seeps into your skin.

death_roll.name: Death Roll
death_roll.stun_text: %s is caught in a death roll!
death_roll.stun_you: The crocodile rolls you under; you can't move!

tide_trunk_blessing.name: Tide-Trunk's Blessing
tide_trunk_blessing.land_text: Cool rain falls on you alone: the Tide-Trunked sees you.
tide_trunk_blessing.desc: For half an hour: +30 hit points and +3 health and mana regeneration. Jalendra's gift to her followers, once an hour at her shrine in Rainhold.

meal_roast_meat.name: Roast Meat
meal_roast_meat.land_text: You eat the roast meat. You feel well fed.
meal_roast_meat.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_grilled_trout.name: Grilled Trout
meal_grilled_trout.land_text: You eat the grilled trout. You feel well fed.
meal_grilled_trout.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_fish_stew.name: Fish Stew
meal_fish_stew.land_text: You eat the fish stew. You feel well fed.
meal_fish_stew.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_hunters_pie.name: Hunter's Pie
meal_hunters_pie.land_text: You eat the hunter's pie. You feel well fed.
meal_hunters_pie.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_frog_legs_saute.name: Sauteed Frog Legs
meal_frog_legs_saute.land_text: You eat the sauteed frog legs. You feel well fed.
meal_frog_legs_saute.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_lagoon_feast.name: Lagoon Feast
meal_lagoon_feast.land_text: You eat the lagoon feast. You feel well fed.
meal_lagoon_feast.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

meal_koi_platter.name: Rainbow Koi Platter
meal_koi_platter.land_text: You eat the rainbow koi platter. You feel well fed.
meal_koi_platter.desc: A good meal: its bonus lasts forty minutes. One meal at a time.

potion_antidote.name: Antidote
potion_antidote.desc: Cures poisons, bleeding and anything slowing you.

potion_draught_of_toughness.name: Draught of Toughness
potion_draught_of_toughness.land_text: Your skin feels hard as chitin.
potion_draught_of_toughness.fade_text: The draught of toughness wears off.

potion_troll_tonic.name: Troll Tonic
potion_troll_tonic.land_text: Your wounds begin to knit like a troll's.

potion_draught_of_swiftness.name: Draught of Swiftness
potion_draught_of_swiftness.fade_text: The draught of swiftness wears off.

call_of_earth.name: Call of Earth
call_of_earth.desc: Summons an earth elemental: slow and tough, it holds a monster's attention. Stronger as you grow.

call_of_water.name: Call of Water
call_of_water.desc: Summons a water elemental: balanced, and its blows chill.

call_of_fire.name: Call of Fire
call_of_fire.desc: Summons a fire elemental: fragile, but it burns hard.

call_of_air.name: Call of Air
call_of_air.desc: Summons an air elemental: quick and hard to pin down; its gusts stagger.

call_of_the_primal.name: Call of the Primal
call_of_the_primal.desc: Summons a primal elemental of storm: stronger than any of the four.

raise_bones.name: Raise Bones
raise_bones.desc: Raises a skeleton to fight for you. It grows into a warrior, then a champion, as you do.

raise_skeletal_knight.name: Raise Skeletal Knight
raise_skeletal_knight.desc: Raises a skeletal knight in cold armor: the strongest servant death gives.

greater_renewal.name: Greater Renewal
greater_renewal.desc: Heals your pet a great deal.

burnout.name: Burnout
burnout.desc: Your pet, for fifteen minutes: 20% faster attacks, +3 damage, +5 AC.

elemental_bond.name: Elemental Bond
elemental_bond.desc: Your pet, for thirty minutes: +15 AC, +5 health a tick.

primal_fury.name: Primal Fury
primal_fury.desc: Your pet, for a minute: 40% faster attacks and +6 damage.

elemental_aegis.name: Elemental Aegis
elemental_aegis.land_text: A shell of living stone closes over your pet.
elemental_aegis.desc: For 8 seconds nothing can harm your pet. Once every two minutes.

mend_bones.name: Mend Bones
mend_bones.desc: Knits your undead pet's bones back together.

dark_empowerment.name: Dark Empowerment
dark_empowerment.land_text: Your pet shudders with dark strength.
dark_empowerment.desc: Your pet, for fifteen minutes: 25% faster attacks and +4 damage.

lifetap.name: Lifetap
lifetap.desc: Drains your target's life into your own.

siphon_life.name: Siphon Life
siphon_life.desc: Draws a great deal of your target's life into your own.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.desc: Tears the life from your target and takes it for yourself.

disease_cloud.name: Disease Cloud
disease_cloud.desc: A creeping disease: damage every tick for 18 seconds.

venom_bolt.name: Venom Bolt
venom_bolt.desc: A bolt of poison that burns for 15 seconds.

bond_of_death.name: Bond of Death
bond_of_death.dot_text: %s's life begins to drain into you.
bond_of_death.desc: Drains your target every tick for 18 seconds, each tick healing you as much.

dread.name: Dread
dread.desc: Your target flees in terror for 10 seconds. Named foes are not so easily frightened.

mass_dread.name: Mass Dread
mass_dread.desc: Every foe within 12 m flees in terror for 8 seconds.

feign_death.name: Feign Death
feign_death.desc: Fall as if slain: everything hunting you forgets you, until you get up. May fail, less often as you practice.

clinging_darkness.name: Clinging Darkness
clinging_darkness.snare_you: Darkness clings to your legs; you slow to a crawl.
clinging_darkness.desc: Your target moves at half speed for 24 seconds.

gust_of_wind.name: Gust of Wind
gust_of_wind.stun_you: A gust of wind knocks you breathless!

false_sunfire.name: False Sunfire
false_sunfire.desc: The false sun's fire, called down by its cultists.

frost_rift.name: Frost Rift
frost_rift.desc: A crack of spirit-cold opens under your foe.

sicken.name: Sicken
sicken.desc: A spirit-sickness: damage every tick for 18 seconds.

strengthen.name: Strengthen
strengthen.desc: A friend, for twenty minutes: +6 strength.

inner_fire.name: Inner Fire
inner_fire.land_text: A warmth kindles in your chest.
inner_fire.desc: A friend, for twenty minutes: +3 armor and +12 health.

drowsy.name: Drowsy
drowsy.slow_text: %s grows drowsy; its blows come slower.
drowsy.slow_you: A drowsiness drags at your arms.
drowsy.desc: Your foe attacks 20% slower for a minute. Named foes shrug off half of it.

spirit_of_bear.name: Spirit of Bear
spirit_of_bear.land_text: The spirit of the bear settles on you.
spirit_of_bear.desc: A friend, for twenty minutes: +6 stamina and +15 health.

spirit_mend.name: Spirit Mend
spirit_mend.desc: Heals a friend over a minute: +4 health every tick.

tainted_breath.name: Tainted Breath
tainted_breath.desc: A poison breath: damage every tick for 18 seconds.

feet_like_cat.name: Feet Like Cat
feet_like_cat.land_text: You feel light on your feet.
feet_like_cat.desc: A friend, for twenty minutes: +8 agility and +2 armor.

walking_sleep.name: Walking Sleep
walking_sleep.slow_text: %s moves as if in a dream.
walking_sleep.slow_you: Your arms move as if in a dream.
walking_sleep.desc: Your foe attacks 30% slower for a minute and a half. Named foes shrug off half of it.

spirit_healing.name: Spirit Healing
spirit_healing.desc: The spirits close a friend's wounds.

quickness.name: Quickness
quickness.desc: A friend, for fifteen minutes: 20% faster attacks.

talisman_of_the_totem.name: Talisman of the Totem
talisman_of_the_totem.land_text: A totem's strength settles on you.
talisman_of_the_totem.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +8 stamina and +30 health.

envenomed_breath.name: Envenomed Breath
envenomed_breath.dot_text: %s gasps as venom fills its lungs.
envenomed_breath.desc: A venomous breath: heavy damage every tick for 18 seconds.

spirit_regrowth.name: Spirit Regrowth
spirit_regrowth.desc: Heals your group over a minute: +6 health every tick.

tagars_insects.name: Tagar's Insects
tagars_insects.slow_text: A cloud of insects swarms %s; its blows falter.
tagars_insects.slow_you: Insects swarm you; you can barely lift your arms.
tagars_insects.desc: Your foe attacks 40% slower for two minutes. Named foes shrug off half of it.

winters_roar.name: Winter's Roar
winters_roar.desc: The howl of a winter spirit.

spirit_of_the_wolf.name: Spirit of the Wolf
spirit_of_the_wolf.desc: A spirit wolf answers your call and fights at your side.

chant_of_the_pack.name: Chant of the Pack
chant_of_the_pack.land_text: The pack's spirit runs in you.
chant_of_the_pack.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +10 strength and +10 agility.

winters_grasp.name: Winter's Grasp
winters_grasp.desc: The spirits of winter crush your foe.

turgurs_insects.name: Turgur's Insects
turgurs_insects.slow_text: Turgur's insects swarm %s; its blows come at half speed.
turgurs_insects.slow_you: Biting insects swarm you; your arms feel like lead.
turgurs_insects.desc: Your foe attacks 50% slower for two and a half minutes. Named foes shrug off half of it.

kraggs_mending.name: Kragg's Mending
kraggs_mending.desc: The ancestors pour their strength into a friend.

ancestral_ward.name: Ancestral Ward
ancestral_ward.land_text: Your ancestors stand guard around you.
ancestral_ward.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +12 stamina, +70 health, +6 armor and +3 health every tick.

homeward.name: Homeward
homeward.desc: Returns you to your bind point after ten seconds of stillness.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.desc: A careful shot: an arrow for 160% of a normal shot's damage.

track.name: Track
track.desc: Reads the ground for what walks nearby: a list of monsters with the way to each and how far, nearest first. Click one to follow it on your compass. The skill reaches further as it grows.

flame_lick.name: Flame Lick
flame_lick.desc: A small fire that burns every tick for 18 seconds.

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.snare_you: Roots grasp at your feet; you slow to a crawl.
ensnare.desc: Your target moves at half speed for 30 seconds.

strength_of_the_wild.name: Strength of the Wild
strength_of_the_wild.land_text: The strength of the wild fills you.
strength_of_the_wild.desc: A friend, for twenty minutes: +8 strength.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: Roots hold your target in place for 18 seconds.

eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.land_text: Your eyes sharpen like an eagle's.
eagle_eye.desc: For twenty minutes: +10 agility and +4 strength.

multishot.name: Multishot
multishot.desc: Three arrows at once: your target and up to two foes near it, each for 90% of a normal shot.

natures_mend.name: Nature's Mend
natures_mend.desc: The forest closes a friend's wounds.

thornskin.name: Thornskin
thornskin.land_text: Your skin hardens like bark and thorn.
thornskin.desc: A friend, for thirty minutes: +8 armor and +25 health.

rapid_fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire.land_text: You nock and loose faster than thought.
rapid_fire.desc: For 30 seconds: 35% faster shots and swings.

barbed_arrow.name: Barbed Arrow
barbed_arrow.desc: A cruel barbed arrow for 220% of a normal shot.

call_of_the_hawk.name: Call of the Hawk
call_of_the_hawk.desc: A hawk answers your whistle and fights at your side.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Five arrows at once: your target and up to four foes near it.

guardian_of_the_wild.name: Guardian of the Wild
guardian_of_the_wild.land_text: The wild stands guard over you.
guardian_of_the_wild.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +8 strength, +8 agility and +6 armor.

natures_renewal.name: Nature's Renewal
natures_renewal.desc: The deep green heals a friend.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: An arrow drawn to the ear, for 300% of a normal shot.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.desc: A raging fire: heavy damage every tick for 18 seconds.

hawks_fury.name: Hawk's Fury
hawks_fury.land_text: Your hawk shrieks and dives in a fury.
hawks_fury.desc: Your companion, for a minute: 40% faster attacks and +8 damage.

trueshot.name: Trueshot
trueshot.desc: The perfect shot, for 400% of a normal shot.

storm_of_arrows.name: Storm of Arrows
storm_of_arrows.desc: Arrows fall like rain: your target and up to seven foes near it, each for 130% of a normal shot.

mighty_blow.name: Mighty Blow
mighty_blow.desc: A crushing blow for heavy damage.

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.land_text: You set your feet; nothing will move you.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: You tear into everything around your target.

dawns_wrath.name: Dawn's Wrath
dawns_wrath.desc: The Dawn-Tusk's light sears your foe.

aegis_of_the_dawn.name: Aegis of the Dawn
aegis_of_the_dawn.land_text: The dawn's aegis settles over you.
aegis_of_the_dawn.desc: Your group, for thirty minutes: +22 armor, +100 health and +3 health every tick.

glacial_spike.name: Glacial Spike
glacial_spike.desc: A spear of ice the size of a man.

mana_ward.name: Mana Ward
mana_ward.land_text: A shell of raw mana surrounds you.
mana_ward.desc: For eight seconds nothing can hurt you. Once every five minutes.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: A storm of fire on your target and everything near it.

shadowstrike.name: Shadowstrike
shadowstrike.desc: From hiding, a strike from the shadows for heavy damage.

blade_flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade_flurry.desc: For 20 seconds: 45% faster attacks and +5 damage.

deathmark.name: Deathmark
deathmark.dot_text: %s bleeds from a deep, marked wound.
deathmark.land_text: A deep wound opens; you are bleeding badly.
deathmark.desc: A marked wound that bleeds heavily for 18 seconds.

primal_surge.name: Primal Surge
primal_surge.land_text: Your pet surges with primal power.
primal_surge.desc: Your pet, for a minute: 45% faster attacks and +10 damage.

call_of_the_elemental_lord.name: Call of the Elemental Lord
call_of_the_elemental_lord.desc: Summons a lord of living fire and stone.

soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul_harvest.desc: Tears the life from your foe into you.

plague.name: Plague
plague.land_text: A plague rots you from within.
plague.desc: A plague: heavy damage every tick for 18 seconds.

raise_bone_colossus.name: Raise Bone Colossus
raise_bone_colossus.desc: Raises a colossus of bones to fight for you.

glacial_roar.name: Glacial Roar
glacial_roar.desc: The roar of the winter spirit itself.

tigirs_swarm.name: Tigir's Swarm
tigirs_swarm.slow_text: Tigir's swarm engulfs %s; its blows barely come.
tigirs_swarm.slow_you: A swarm engulfs you; your arms are lead.
tigirs_swarm.desc: Your foe attacks 60% slower for three minutes. Named foes shrug off half of it.

ancestral_avatar.name: Ancestral Avatar
ancestral_avatar.desc: A friend, for ten minutes: +20 strength, +20 agility, 25% faster attacks and +6 damage.

harpy_shriek.name: Harpy Shriek
harpy_shriek.stun_you: A piercing shriek leaves you reeling!

cinder_bolt.name: Cinder Bolt
cinder_bolt.desc: The ember cult's bolt of burning cinders.

meal_terrace_tea.name: Terrace Tea
meal_terrace_tea.land_text: The tea warms you and clears your head.
meal_terrace_tea.desc: Forty minutes: +2 mana a tick and +3 wisdom.

mud_spit.name: Mud Spit
mud_spit.snare_you: A gob of mud clogs your legs; you slow to a crawl.

bog_bolt.name: Bog Bolt
bog_bolt.desc: A mudcaller's bolt of stinking bogwater.

eel_shock.name: Eel Shock
eel_shock.stun_text: %s jerks as the shock runs through it.
eel_shock.stun_you: A jolt from the eel locks your muscles!

hex_of_rot.name: Hex of Rot
hex_of_rot.land_text: A witch's hex rots your flesh.
